sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Bracelet Combo Set – Sparkling Crystal Tennis Bracelet & Sleek Snake Chain
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your glamour with this chic gold-toned bracelet duo. Combining a brilliant crystal-studded tennis strand with a modern flat snake chain, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To preserve its radiant luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely in a dry place after every wear.
